title: Flood welfare check
purpose: check that the person is safe from rising water and find out if they need help to move
questions: Is water entering your home or blocking the road outside?
Are you able to get upstairs or to higher ground on your own if you need to?
Do you have your medications, drinking water, and a working phone with you?
Is there anything you need: help moving, a ride to a shelter, your medication, or someone to come by?
confusion_probe: If the person seems confused or disoriented, gently ask once: Can you tell me what day it is today?
red_flags: water already inside the home and the person cannot move to higher ground
advice: Do not walk or drive through moving water.
Move valuables and medications to an upper floor now while it is easy.
Keep your phone charged and near you.
red_flag_instruction: If the person is trapped, cannot move away from water, or reports a medical emergency, tell them calmly to call {{emergency_number}} now, and that you are alerting their emergency contact. Do not advise them to enter water.
voicemail_message: This is an automated welfare call from {{org}} because of flooding in your area. Please move to higher ground if water is rising and call {{emergency_number}} if you are trapped. We will try again shortly.

escalation_reason_templates.red: reported being at risk during our flood welfare call: {{reasons}}
escalation_reason_templates.unreachable: could not be reached by phone after {{attempts}} attempts during the flood warning
escalation_reason_templates.unverified: answered but we could not confirm they are safe
